title: FREAK MAG - Bookshelf Spine Navigation

affordance_translation.physical_behavior: Books leaning against gravity on a shelf, vertical spine typography, colored dust jackets.
affordance_translation.digital_mechanic: Full-height vertical card layout standing side-by-side; leftmost card tilted via 2D rotation; horizontal shelf divider grounds the base.

design_tokens.borders: 1px to 2px solid black keylines, 0px border radius
design_tokens.elevation: Flat, 0px shadow; depth achieved through 2D tilt transformation
design_tokens.typography: Vertical CJK Gothic text paired with rotated monospace dates and bold numerals

interactive_mechanics: Hover triggers a slight Y-axis lift or forward translation
Clicking a spine expands the column into an article archive drawer
usability_notes: High visual memorability and strong editorial personality. Best suited for small curated collections under 15–20 items; vertical text can introduce legibility friction for non-CJK alphabets.

title: Mosby's Files - Filing Cabinet & Index Tab Navigation

affordance_translation.physical_behavior: Stacked filing drawers with protruding rounded index tabs; folders pull out of the drawer without disturbing the archive; desk clutter (paperclips, scissors, rulers, index cards) overlaps loose-leaf paper.
affordance_translation.digital_mechanic: Homepage presents four color-coded stacked drawer bars; each protruding tab is a clickable folder that opens in place, preserving spatial context. In dossier comparison view, horizontal tabs rotate 90 degrees onto the right margin as persistent navigation.

design_tokens.borders: Minimal keylines; folder edges defined by saturated flat color blocks with rounded tab corners (~8px), 0-1px radius elsewhere
design_tokens.elevation: Flat layered stacking; depth via overlapping z-index (index cards, prints, paperclips) rather than drop shadows
design_tokens.typography: Heavy condensed uppercase grotesque display (American Modernism headline), serif for folder-tab names and drop-cap essays, monospace for dates and metadata

interactive_mechanics: Hover/Click on a protruding tab pulls that folder open while surrounding drawers remain in place
Comparison mode rotates tabs 90 degrees onto the right margin as a vertical tab rail for non-linear navigation
Playable embedded artifacts (waveform cards, audio spools, video buttons) styled as physical desk objects
usability_notes: Color-coded drawers create strong spatial memory and editorial personality; best for curated archives of 5-15 top-level categories. Overlapping desk-clutter collage risks legibility friction on mobile and needs careful contrast management; tab-rotation pattern requires orientation cues for screen readers.

title: Madeline's Mobile - Kitchen Ticket Scroll Layout

affordance_translation.physical_behavior: A restaurant kitchen order ticket: narrow paper roll, single monospaced typeface, ASCII section rules, handwritten patron signature and margin scribbles at the bottom.
affordance_translation.digital_mechanic: Entire website lives inside a narrow (~300px) vertical scroll frame styled as a continuously printed ticket; ASCII characters delineate sections; a sticky dropdown collapses to a single line highlighting the current section as you scroll.

design_tokens.borders: ASCII-rule separators (dashes, pipes, equals signs) instead of CSS borders; no rounded corners
design_tokens.elevation: Completely flat; paper illusion carried by typography and spacing, not shadow
design_tokens.typography: Single monospaced typeface, one weight throughout; scribbled handwritten annotations for signature and margin notes

interactive_mechanics: Sticky top dropdown menu transforms into a single highlighted line tracking scroll position
Long-form vertical scroll reads as one continuously printing receipt
usability_notes: Extremely strong brand concept for hospitality (half of users browse on-site for menus). Single typeface and one weight enforce simplicity; seekers can jump via the sticky menu. Constraints: the 300px frame sacrifices horizontal content richness, and decorative scribbles must never carry wayfinding meaning. Approximated tokens - live site could not be fetched, details sourced from Communication Arts project coverage.
